findingDetails.title: Phase 007 closure text says the permission split is absent after it landed
findingDetails.case: The phase closure statement says the two-job Dependabot split is not built while task T019 and the current workflow show it is implemented.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The finding concerns phase 007 acceptance and closure statements; the workflow was read only as evidence.

results.check: Phase 007 closure security state matches task and workflow evidence

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The review crosses phase design, acceptance evidence, task execution, and active workflow permission boundaries.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Selected the security-sensitive controls and the phase 007 evidence that claims its permission boundary was or was not implemented.
omittedHighRiskTargets: A live Dependabot security-patch run that reaches the write-scoped merge job; recorded runs both skipped that job.

searchLedger.invariant: Repository variable values must not be included in report output.

searchActions.result: Values are reduced to off/other/unset/unknown state labels before rendering.

searchLedger.rationale: The read path retains only state labels and the report renders those labels.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No variable value reaches the returned report object or table.

searchLedger.hypothesis: CLI-derived values might reach shell parsing or an unchecked API path.

searchActions.result: gh is spawned with an argument array; run SHAs are validated against a 40-lowercase-hex pattern before URL use.

searchLedger.rationale: The reviewed process call does not invoke a shell and interpolated SHA input is validated.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No command-shell interpolation path was found in this call flow.

searchLedger.invariant: A required message-contract status check must remain enabled.

searchActions.queryOrPath: toggle allowlist, mutation boundary, approval step, and README required-context rule
searchActions.result: The route limits names and values, requires explicit yes, excludes secret/org variables, and refuses both the message group and master switch while the context is required.

searchLedger.rationale: The protected group and master switch have explicit refusal rules tied to the README restriction.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The reviewed toggle path contains explicit guardrails for the only required check.

searchLedger.invariant: Third-party code must not execute in the job holding repository write scopes.

searchActions.result: The metadata action runs in a read-only job; the write-scoped job has no checkout and runs only gh pr merge.

searchLedger.rationale: The current workflow structurally separates the third-party action from write scopes.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No repository code or third-party action runs in the write-scoped job.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The closure statement may lag the implementation evidence for the permission split.

searchActions.queryOrPath: AC-002 and closure statement compared with T019 and current workflow
searchActions.result: Closure says the split is absent; T019 is complete and the current workflow has the split.

searchLedger.rationale: Direct comparison confirmed the phase closure explanation is stale.

searchLedger.invariant: The write-scoped auto-merge branch should have recorded evidence for its intended security-patch condition.

searchActions.queryOrPath: T022 evidence and AC-002 live-run requirement
searchActions.result: Two real Dependabot runs are recorded, but both skipped the write-scoped job and the task says the security-patch path was not observed.

searchLedger.rationale: This review is read-only and the live evidence is explicitly incomplete.
searchLedger.deferredReason: The recorded Dependabot updates do not exercise the security-patch auto-merge branch; retain AC-002 as unmet until that proof is recorded.
